headline: Police suspect racist motive behind Kafr Qasim car ramming that injured 8 people
label: BREAKING
caption:
Police are investigating a possible racist motive behind a violent car ramming incident. 🚨

According to The Times of Israel, police suspect a racist motive behind a car ramming in Kafr Qasim that left 8 people injured.

Authorities are continuing to investigate the circumstances surrounding the attack.
